name: pg_reactive
abstract: Reactive live queries for PostgreSQL with real-time delta notifications
description: pg_reactive turns SQL SELECTs into live queries. Subscribe with pgr.subscribe('id', 'SELECT ...'); the extension tracks table and column dependencies in shared memory, auto-installs statement triggers, recomputes EXCEPT-based deltas against UNLOGGED snapshots, and emits JSON deltas over LISTEN/NOTIFY — one channel for all queries, with per-subscription generations for safe re-registration. Optional background worker for async recompute. Supports PostgreSQL 15 through 18 (each version proven by the full pg_regress + isolation suite in CI).
